Before: E hënë–E premte, 09:00–18:00
After / suggestion: E hënë–e premte, 09:00–18:00
Reviewer's reason: Days of the week are lowercase in Albanian; only the first word of the line is capitalised.

Before: Plotëso të gjitha fushat përpara dërgimit.
After / suggestion: Plotëso të gjitha fushat e detyrueshme përpara dërgimit.
Reviewer's reason: 'required' was dropped, so the message tells people to fill ALL fields, including the ones marked optional.

Before: Duke dërguar formularin pajtohesh me {link}.
After / suggestion: Duke dërguar formularin, pajtohesh me {link}.
Reviewer's reason: A sentence-initial 'duke' (gerund) phrase is set off with a comma.

Before: Çmimet janë pikënisje. Oferta finale konfirmohet pasi shohim gjendjen tuaj.
After / suggestion: Çmimet janë pikënisje. Oferta finale konfirmohet pasi të shohim gjendjen e sistemeve të tua.
Reviewer's reason: 'tuaj' (formal ju) breaks the informal 'ti' used across the Home page; future 'after' needs the subjunctive 'pasi të shohim' (plain 'pasi shohim' can read as 'since we see'); 'gjendjen e sistemeve të tua' renders 'your setup'.

Before: Backup dhe disaster recovery
After / suggestion: Backup dhe rikuperim në rast emergjence
Reviewer's reason: 'disaster recovery' is untranslated jargon for business owners; the site elsewhere says 'rikuperim'/'plan rikuperimi'. Keeping the English term is acceptable if this plan targets technical buyers.
Decision: Kept: The current site already says 'Backup & Disaster Recovery' in this package.

Before: Formularë, WhatsApp dhe rrugë kontakti të dukshme
After / suggestion: Dizajn profesional që mbetet i njëtrajtshëm në çdo pajisje
Reviewer's reason: Meaning mismatch: Albanian says 'Forms, WhatsApp and visible contact paths'; English is 'Professional design that stays consistent on every device'. The whole Albanian bullet list for this service differs from the English (bullets 0, 2, 3 are older copy, and bullet 2 already starts 'Dizajn profesional...'), so consider aligning all four bullets.
Decision: Kept: These Albanian bullets are the current site's own wording; the suggestion would duplicate the next bullet.

Before: Qëndrojmë të përfshirë me monitorim, përditësime dhe suport.
After / suggestion: Mbetemi pranë ekipit me monitorim, përditësime dhe suport.
Reviewer's reason: 'Qëndrojmë të përfshirë me' is a literal calque of 'stay involved with' (the collocation is 'të përfshirë në'); 'Qëndrojmë pranë' matches the Home page step text.

Before: Dërgo kërkesën ose cakto një bisedë. Të kthehemi me hapat e parë: çfarë ka prioritet, çfarë duhet sqaruar dhe si fillojmë.
After / suggestion: Dërgo kërkesën ose cakto një bisedë. Ne të kthehemi me hapat e parë: çfarë ka prioritet, çfarë duhet sqaruar dhe si fillojmë.
Reviewer's reason: Sentence-initial 'Të kthehemi' reads first as the hortative 'Let's go back'; adding 'ne' makes it clearly 'we get back to you'.

Before: Nxjerr pikat kryesore
After / suggestion: Nxjerr në pah vendimet
Reviewer's reason: English is 'Highlights decisions'; 'Nxjerr pikat kryesore' means 'extracts the key points' and drops 'decisions' (the benefit line is 'Vendime më të qarta'). Alternatively adjust the English.
Decision: Kept: Restored to the current site's wording 'Nxjerr pika kryesore'.

Before: Për kompanitë, AI duhet të jetë i dobishëm dhe i kontrolluar. Ndërtojmë role, aprovime, histori veprimesh dhe kufij të qartë për të dhënat.
After / suggestion: Për kompanitë, AI duhet të jetë i dobishëm dhe i kontrolluar. Ndërtojmë role, aprovime, historik veprimesh dhe kufij të qartë për të dhënat.
Reviewer's reason: Terminology: the same section's list and the Services page say 'historik veprimesh' (action log); 'histori' means history/story.

Before: Përshkruaj procesin, mjetet që përdorni dhe çfarë do të automatizosh. Të kthehemi me rastin më të mirë për një pilot.
After / suggestion: Përshkruaj procesin, mjetet që përdor dhe çfarë do të automatizosh. Ne të kthehemi me rastin më të mirë për një pilot.
Reviewer's reason: Mixed address in one sentence: 'përdorni' (ju) next to 'Përshkruaj'/'automatizosh' (ti); use 'përdor'. Also sentence-initial 'Të kthehemi' reads as 'Let's go back'; 'Ne të kthehemi' is unambiguous.

Before: Video të shkurtra, lëvizje grafike, intro, reklama dhe materiale të animuara për prezantim.
After / suggestion: Video të shkurtra, motion graphics, intro, reklama dhe materiale të animuara për prezantim.
Reviewer's reason: 'lëvizje grafike' is a word-for-word rendering of 'motion graphics' that reads as 'graphic movements'; the section already uses 'motion' as a loanword.
Decision: Kept: 'lëvizje grafike' is the current site's wording.

Before: Mjafton një ide e shkurtër, një nevojë e markës ose një qëllim fushate. Të kthehemi me drejtim vizual, hapat e radhës dhe ofertë për punën.
After / suggestion: Mjafton një ide e shkurtër, një nevojë e markës ose një qëllim fushate. Ne të kthehemi me drejtim vizual, hapat e radhës dhe ofertë për punën.
Reviewer's reason: Sentence-initial 'Të kthehemi' reads first as the hortative 'Let's go back'; adding 'ne' makes it clearly 'we get back to you'.

Before: IT Department mund ta lidhë faqen, sistemin, marketingun dhe prezencën vizuale që të gjitha të shkojnë në të njëjtin drejtim.
After / suggestion: IT Department mund t'i lidhë faqen, sistemin, marketingun dhe prezencën vizuale, që të gjitha të shkojnë në të njëjtin drejtim.
Reviewer's reason: The object is four coordinated nouns, so the doubling clitic must be plural: 't'i lidhë', not 'ta lidhë'. A comma before the purpose clause 'që të gjitha...' also helps.

Before: Ekip teknologjie që ndërton dhe kujdeset për sistemet me të cilat punojnë bizneset.
After / suggestion: Ekip teknologjie që ndërton dhe mirëmban sistemet me të cilat punojnë bizneset.
Reviewer's reason: 'ndërton' (direct object) and 'kujdeset për' (preposition) cannot cleanly share 'sistemet', so 'ndërton' is left without an object; 'ndërton dhe mirëmban' matches the Home and About lead wording.

Before: Na trego çfarë të duhet. Të kthehemi me hapin e radhës.
After / suggestion: Na trego çfarë të duhet. Ne të kthehemi me hapin e radhës.
Reviewer's reason: Sentence-initial 'Të kthehemi' reads first as the hortative 'Let's go back'; adding 'ne' makes it clearly 'we get back to you'. This is the Contact page H1.

Before: Përshkruaj projektin, problemin ose auditimin që të duhet dhe të kthehemi me hapat e radhës.
After / suggestion: Përshkruaj projektin, problemin ose auditimin që të duhet dhe ne të kthehemi me hapat e radhës.
Reviewer's reason: After an imperative, 'dhe të kthehemi' reads as 'and let's go back'; 'dhe ne të kthehemi' makes it 'and we get back to you'.

Before: Faqja përdor shërbime të sigurta për formularë, takime dhe komunikim. Këto shërbime mund të përpunojnë të dhëna sipas rregullave të tyre.
After / suggestion: Faqja përdor shërbime të besueshme për formularë, takime dhe komunikim. Këto shërbime mund të përpunojnë të dhëna sipas rregullave të tyre.
Reviewer's reason: Meaning shift in a legal text: English says 'trusted' services; 'të sigurta' claims they are 'secure/safe'. 'të besueshme' = trusted.
Decision: Kept: Legal text: restored word for word from the current privacy page. The reviewer notes that 'të sigurta' (secure) differs from the English 'trusted'; worth a look by whoever owns the policy.

Before: Na shkruani në {email} ose në WhatsApp te {phone}.
After / suggestion: Na shkruani në {email} ose në WhatsApp, në numrin {phone}.
Reviewer's reason: 'te' is used for people/places; with a phone number Albanian says 'në numrin'. Formal 'shkruani' kept because the Privacy page consistently uses 'ju'.
Decision: Kept: Legal text: current site's wording.

Before: Na shkruani në {email} ose në WhatsApp te {phone}.
After / suggestion: Na shkruani në {email} ose në WhatsApp, në numrin {phone}.
Reviewer's reason: 'te' is used for people/places; with a phone number Albanian says 'në numrin'. Formal 'shkruani' kept because the Terms page consistently uses 'ju'.
Decision: Kept: Legal text: current site's wording.

Before: Nxjerr pikat kryesore
After / suggestion: Nxjerr pika kryesore
Reviewer's reason: Consistency with the accepted fixes

Before: 30-Min-Gespräch buchen
After / suggestion: 30-Minuten-Gespräch buchen
Reviewer's reason: 'Min' without a period is neither the abbreviation 'Min.' nor the unit symbol 'min'; the spelled-out compound is the clean form and matches '30 Minuten' on the contact page.

Before: Website, Software und IT-Support.
After / suggestion: Websites, Software und IT-Support.
Reviewer's reason: English and the home H1 use the plural 'Websites'; the singular reads like 'a website' and is inconsistent with R010/R032.

Before: Websites, Software, AI Agents, IT-Support und Cybersicherheit für Unternehmen, die klarer arbeiten und sicherere Systeme wollen.
After / suggestion: Websites, Software, AI Agents, IT-Support und Cybersicherheit für Unternehmen, die klarere Abläufe und sicherere Systeme wollen.
Reviewer's reason: 'die klarer arbeiten und … wollen' naturally parses as 'companies that (already) work more clearly and want safer systems'; 'klarere Abläufe' keeps the intended 'want clearer work'.

Before: Alles, was Ihr Unternehmen von der Technologie braucht, an einem Ort.
After / suggestion: Alles, was Ihr Unternehmen an Technologie braucht, aus einer Hand.
Reviewer's reason: 'von der Technologie braucht' is a calque of 'needs from technology'; idiomatic is 'an Technologie braucht'. 'aus einer Hand' is the standard German phrase for one-stop services (keeping 'an einem Ort' is also acceptable).

Before: Unternehmenswebsites und Landingpages, die Ihr Angebot klar erklären, schnell laden und den Kontakt einfach machen.
After / suggestion: Unternehmenswebsites und Landingpages, die Ihr Angebot klar erklären, schnell laden und die Kontaktaufnahme erleichtern.
Reviewer's reason: 'den Kontakt einfach machen' is a literal rendering of 'make contact easy'; 'die Kontaktaufnahme erleichtern' is the natural collocation.

Before: Drei einfache Pakete, von Basis-Support bis zur kompletten Betreuung Ihrer IT-Umgebung.
After / suggestion: Drei einfache Pakete, vom Basis-Support bis zur kompletten Betreuung Ihrer IT-Umgebung.
Reviewer's reason: Parallel range construction: 'vom … bis zur …' (article on both sides) instead of 'von … bis zur …'.

Before: Die Preise sind ein Ausgangspunkt. Das endgültige Angebot wird nach Prüfung Ihrer Umgebung bestätigt.
After / suggestion: Die Preise sind Richtwerte. Das endgültige Angebot wird nach Prüfung Ihrer IT-Umgebung bestätigt.
Reviewer's reason: 'Die Preise sind ein Ausgangspunkt' is a literal translation; 'Richtwerte' is the usual wording. 'Ihrer Umgebung' alone is vague; 'IT-Umgebung' matches the lead above.

Before: Klare Leistungen, ohne technisches Rauschen.
After / suggestion: Klare Leistungen, ohne unnötige Fachsprache.
Reviewer's reason: 'technisches Rauschen' reads as literal signal noise (static) in German; 'ohne Fachjargon' (or 'ohne technischen Ballast') carries the intended 'without the technical noise'.

Before: ein Werkzeug, das täglich genutzt wird, nicht ein Projekt, das ungenutzt bleibt.
After / suggestion: ein Werkzeug, das täglich genutzt wird, kein Projekt, das ungenutzt bleibt.
Reviewer's reason: In an 'X, not Y' contrast German negates the indefinite noun with 'kein', not 'nicht ein'.

Before: Wir trennen, was automatisiert werden kann, was Freigabe braucht und was bei Menschen bleibt.
After / suggestion: Wir unterscheiden, was automatisiert werden kann, was eine Freigabe braucht und was bei Menschen bleibt.
Reviewer's reason: 'trennen' needs 'von' (X von Y trennen) and does not take a list of what-clauses naturally; 'unterscheiden' fits. 'was eine Freigabe braucht' needs the article.

Before: Beschreiben Sie den Prozess, die genutzten Tools und was automatisiert werden soll. Wir melden uns mit dem besten ersten Anwendungsfall für einen Pilot.
After / suggestion: Beschreiben Sie den Prozess, die genutzten Tools und was automatisiert werden soll. Wir melden uns mit dem besten ersten Anwendungsfall für ein Pilotprojekt.
Reviewer's reason: 'Pilot' is a weak masculine noun, so the accusative is 'einen Piloten', not 'einen Pilot'. 'ein Pilotprojekt' avoids the declension and the aviation reading ('einen Piloten' is also correct).

Before: Was wir bauen und warum es wichtig ist. Diese Beispiele beschreiben die Arbeit ohne Nennung des Kunden. Fragen Sie uns nach dem Fall, der Ihrer Branche am nächsten kommt.
After / suggestion: Was wir bauen und warum es wichtig ist. Diese Beispiele beschreiben die Arbeit ohne Nennung des Kunden. Fragen Sie uns nach dem Projekt, das Ihrer Branche am nächsten kommt.
Reviewer's reason: A bare 'der Fall' sounds like a legal or medical case; 'Projekt' (or 'Fallbeispiel') is what a German reader expects here.

Before: Technische Struktur kombiniert mit kreativer Umsetzung, damit Kommunikation so seriös wirkt wie das System dahinter.
After / suggestion: Technische Struktur kombiniert mit kreativer Umsetzung, damit die Kommunikation so seriös wirkt wie das System dahinter.
Reviewer's reason: Specific reference ('as the system behind it') needs the article: 'die Kommunikation'. Without it the sentence reads like a generic statement about communication.

Before: Vom Onlineshop bis zu Team-, Auftrags-, Lager- und Reporting-Management: Ein Projekt kann klein starten und zu einem vollen System wachsen.
After / suggestion: Vom Onlineshop bis zum Team-, Auftrags-, Lager- und Reporting-Management: Ein Projekt kann klein starten und zu einem vollständigen System wachsen.
Reviewer's reason: Parallel 'Vom … bis zum …'. 'ein volles System' is not idiomatic for 'a full system'; use 'vollständigen' (or 'vollwertigen').

Before: Wir schauen es gemeinsam an und machen daraus einen Plan.
After / suggestion: Wir schauen es uns gemeinsam an und machen daraus einen Plan.
Reviewer's reason: 'sich etwas anschauen' is reflexive in this sense ('take a look at'); without 'uns' it sounds non-native.

Before: Hallo, ich interessiere mich für Kreativarbeit und digitales Marketing.
After / suggestion: Hallo, ich interessiere mich für Kreativleistungen und digitales Marketing.
Reviewer's reason: 'Kreativarbeit' drops 'services' and can read as a personal interest in doing creative work (like a job enquiry); 'Kreativleistungen' matches 'creative … services'.

Before: Sagen Sie uns, was schärfer aussehen soll.
After / suggestion: Sagen Sie uns, was professioneller wirken soll.
Reviewer's reason: 'schärfer aussehen' is a literal translation of 'look sharper' and in colloquial German 'scharf aussehen' means 'look hot/sexy'. 'professioneller wirken' matches the page ('professioneller wirken lassen'). 'was einen schärferen Auftritt braucht' would keep the metaphor.

Before: Eine kurze Idee, ein Markenbedarf oder ein Kampagnenziel reicht. Wir melden uns mit visueller Richtung, nächsten Schritten und einem Angebot.
After / suggestion: Eine kurze Idee, ein Anliegen zur Marke oder ein Kampagnenziel reicht. Wir melden uns mit einer visuellen Richtung, den nächsten Schritten und einem Angebot.
Reviewer's reason: 'Markenbedarf' is an unidiomatic coinage (reads like 'demand for branded goods'); 'ein Anliegen zur Marke' says 'brand need'. The list after 'mit' mixes bare nouns with 'einem Angebot'; add the articles.

Before: Wachsende Unternehmen, Teams mit Standardbedarf, Firmen mit stärkerem Sicherheitsanspruch und Organisationen, die seriöser auftreten wollen.
After / suggestion: Wachsende Unternehmen, Teams mit Bedarf an Standards, Firmen mit höheren Sicherheitsansprüchen und Organisationen, die seriöser auftreten wollen.
Reviewer's reason: Meaning error: 'Standardbedarf' means 'ordinary/standard demand', not 'a need for standards'. Also the idiomatic collocation is 'höhere Sicherheitsansprüche', not 'stärkerer Sicherheitsanspruch'.

Before: Sie benötigen IT-Support, Sicherheit, eine Website, Software oder KI in Prishtina und Kosovo? Buchen Sie ein kurzes Gespräch oder senden Sie eine schriftliche Anfrage.
After / suggestion: Sie benötigen IT-Support, Sicherheit, eine Website, Software oder KI in Prishtina und im Kosovo? Buchen Sie ein kurzes Gespräch oder senden Sie eine schriftliche Anfrage.
Reviewer's reason: Standard German uses the article with Kosovo ('im Kosovo'), as the site already does in R078 and R190. Note: the same 'in Prishtina und Kosovo' also appears in existing (reused) strings: services desc and services items 0 and 3.

Before: Websites für Unternehmen in Prishtina und Kosovo:
After / suggestion: Websites für Unternehmen in Prishtina und im Kosovo:
Reviewer's reason: Consistency with the accepted fixes

Before: IT-Support für Unternehmen in Prishtina und Kosovo:
After / suggestion: IT-Support für Unternehmen in Prishtina und im Kosovo:
Reviewer's reason: Consistency with the accepted fixes

Before: …Kraken Communications für Kundengespräche und AURA, ein privater Sprachassistent.
After / suggestion: …Kraken Communications für Kundengespräche sowie der private Sprachassistent AURA.
Reviewer's reason: Nested list: 'und AURA' read as part of 'für Kundengespräche'.

Before: Drei Produkte. Ein Zuhause.
After / suggestion: Drei Produkte. Unter einem Dach.
Reviewer's reason: 'Ein Zuhause' sounds translated; 'unter einem Dach' is the idiom.

Before: Sehen Sie das Produkt mit Ihrem eigenen Ablauf.
After / suggestion: Erleben Sie das Produkt mit Ihren eigenen Abläufen.
Reviewer's reason: Literal 'sehen … mit einem Ablauf'.

Before: Eine Demo mit Ihrem Kanal und Ihrem Arbeitsprozess.
After / suggestion: Eine Demo, zugeschnitten auf Ihren Kanal und die Arbeitsweise Ihres Teams.
Reviewer's reason: Restores 'built around' and 'your team'; less stiff.

Before: …Lager und Prognose…
After / suggestion: …Lagerbestand und Prognose…
Reviewer's reason: 'Stock' on a dashboard is the stock level.

Before: Was es ist
After / suggestion: Überblick
Reviewer's reason: Literal label.

Before: …eine modulare Plattform zur Organisation von Unternehmen.
After / suggestion: …eine modulare Plattform, mit der Sie Ihr Unternehmen organisieren.
Reviewer's reason: Reviewer proposed 'zur Unternehmenssteuerung'; changed differently because the source says organising the business (Unternehmenssteuerung sounds like ERP/controlling).

Before: …Finanzen, Menschen und Ressourcen.
After / suggestion: …Finanzen, Personal und Ressourcen.
Reviewer's reason: 'Menschen' is odd in a module list; matches the HR module.

Before: Gemeinsame Funktionen
After / suggestion: Übergreifende Funktionen
Reviewer's reason: Usual term for functions shared across modules.

Before: Lager
After / suggestion: Lager & Bestand
Reviewer's reason: 'Stock' had been dropped.

Before: Anlagen
After / suggestion: Anlagenverwaltung
Reviewer's reason: 'Anlagen' alone can mean attachments.

Before: Gastronomie-Kasse (POS)
After / suggestion: Gastronomiekasse (POS)
Reviewer's reason: Usually written as one word.

Before: Der Kontakt entsteht im CRM, …
After / suggestion: Der Kontakt wird im CRM angelegt, …
Reviewer's reason: 'anlegen' is the standard CRM verb.

Before: …Entscheidungen, verbunden auf einer Plattform.
After / suggestion: …Entscheidungen, vereint auf einer Plattform.
Reviewer's reason: Unusual collocation 'verbunden auf'.

Before: …Nachverfolgung und Angeboten im Gespräch.
After / suggestion: …Nachverfolgung und verknüpften Angeboten.
Reviewer's reason: 'im Gespräch' also means 'under discussion'. Reviewer proposed 'direkt aus dem Gespräch'; not used because offers are linked to the conversation, not created in it (deck slide 10).

Before: …vor dem Einsatz privat getestet.
After / suggestion: …vor dem Einsatz intern getestet.
Reviewer's reason: 'privat' means personal in German.

Before: Was enthalten ist
After / suggestion: Leistungsumfang
Reviewer's reason: Standard B2B label.

Before: Berichte und Teamarbeit
After / suggestion: Berichte und Teamaktivität
Reviewer's reason: 'Teamarbeit' means teamwork, not team activity.

Before: …për bisedat me klientët dhe AURA, asistent privat me zë.
After / suggestion: …për bisedat me klientët, si dhe AURA, asistent privat me zë.
Reviewer's reason: Could be read as 'conversations with clients and AURA'.

Before: Tre produkte. Një shtëpi.
After / suggestion: Tri produkte. Një shtëpi.
Reviewer's reason: Standard agreement: 'produkte' takes feminine agreement in the plural ('tri', as in 'Tri shtresa').

Before: …nga website chat, Instagram…
After / suggestion: …nga Website chat, Instagram…
Reviewer's reason: Lowercase English mid-sentence looked untranslated; written as the channel name, like the chip.

Before: Mëson si punon përdoruesi dhe i kthen kërkesat në detyra dhe takime.
After / suggestion: Mëson si punon dhe i kthen kërkesat e tua në detyra dhe takime konkrete.
Reviewer's reason: 'përdoruesi' broke the informal 'ti' address; 'konkrete' restores 'real'. Reviewer wording adapted ('si punon ti' → 'si punon … kërkesat e tua').

Before: Pamje paraprake
After / suggestion: Version paraprak / Në zhvillim
Reviewer's reason: Reviewer: 'pamje paraprake' is the software 'preview' term. Kept: both alternatives claim a product stage nobody confirmed, and the report itself says AURA is shown as a 'pamje'.

Before: Shihe produktin me procesin tënd.
After / suggestion: Shihe produktin në procesin tënd.
Reviewer's reason: 'me' copies the English 'with'.

Before: …ndërsa menaxhimi sheh pamjen e përgjithshme.
After / suggestion: …ndërsa menaxhmenti sheh pamjen e përgjithshme.
Reviewer's reason: 'menaxhimi' is the activity; the people are 'menaxhmenti'.

Before: Testimi i rrjedhave
After / suggestion: Testimi i rrjedhave të punës
Reviewer's reason: 'rrjedhave' alone is vague.

Before: …dhe shërbimet AI…
After / suggestion: …dhe shërbimet e AI-së…
Reviewer's reason: English word order; matches 'njohuritë e AI-së'.

Before: …bisedat e hapura, të pacaktuara dhe kërkesat me afat të kaluar
After / suggestion: …bisedat e hapura dhe të pacaktuara, si dhe kërkesat me afat të kaluar
Reviewer's reason: The screenshot card says 'Overdue requests', so the Albanian was right; the English and German alt texts were corrected to 'overdue requests' instead.

Before: Marrja e bisedës…
After / suggestion: Marrja përsipër e bisedës…
Reviewer's reason: Plain 'marrja' can read as receiving a conversation.

Before: Një paketë, e qartë.
After / suggestion: Një paketë, e përcaktuar qartë.
Reviewer's reason: 'e qartë' alone loses 'defined'.
